products.name: Bona Traffic HD
products.scope: U.S. technical data sheet. Confirm the schedule in cooler or more humid rooms.

walking.text: The US sheet gives 24 hours for walking. Treat the surface gently while it cures.

furniture.text: Ask the installer for a furniture return time. The sheet gives pad guidance and a separate walking time.

rugs.text: Wait until the finish has fully cured before returning rugs.

cleaning.text: Use a dry microfiber mop or cloth during the first week. Confirm the specified cleaner for later use.

cure.text: The US sheet gives approximately 3 days for full cure.

products.name: LOBA 2K Supra A.T. satin
products.scope: U.S. satin sheet. Its stated times assume 68 °F and 50% relative humidity at the recommended application rate.

sources.label: LOBA US satin technical data sheet

walking.text: The sheet lists normal traffic after 12 hours under its stated conditions.

furniture.text: Confirm a separate time for furniture. The care section calls for felt pads and careful placement.

rugs.text: Wait for final cure before setting rugs or carpets on the finish. Check pad compatibility with the installer.

cleaning.text: The care section holds off water and detergent for the first week and calls for full cure before damp cleaning.

cure.text: The US satin sheet lists 3 days under the stated conditions. Ventilation, humidity, temperature and coat thickness can extend it.

products.name: Rubio Monocoat Oil Plus 2C
products.scope: U.S. guidance for the two-part system. Confirm whether Part B was used.

walking.text: The care note gives about 24–36 hours for light use under favorable conditions. The flooring FAQ specifies clean, dry socks for early walking.

furniture.text: The flooring FAQ lists 48 hours for furniture. It excludes rugs and mats at that point.

rugs.text: The FAQ excludes rugs and mats at the 48-hour furniture milestone. Ask for the actual rug and pad return date.

cleaning.text: The flooring FAQ lists about 5 days to full cure and liquid resistance. Confirm the first damp cleaning date and product separately.

cure.text: Rubio lists about 5 days with Part B and about 21 days when Part A was used alone.

products.name: PALLMANN PALL-X GOLD
products.scope: July 2026 product data sheet for the North American product.

walking.text: The sheet lists 3–4 hours in the drying table and 24 hours in the cure instructions. Get a written walking time from the installer for this floor.

furniture.text: Ask the installer to confirm a separate furniture return time for the installed finish.

rugs.text: Ask when rugs and their actual backing or pads can be placed on this finish.

cleaning.text: The cure instructions call for dry untreated dusting or a dry lint-free cloth during the first week.

cure.text: The July 2026 sheet describes roughly 3 days to full cure under its listed conditions.

products.name: Basic Coatings StreetShoe NXT
products.scope: Technical sheet for this product with XL Catalyst.

walking.text: The technical sheet generally allows light foot traffic after 24 hours.

furniture.text: The sheet describes careful furniture placement while the surface can still mar. Confirm the date and handling for your furniture.

rugs.text: The sheet calls for at least 2 weeks after the finish has dried before covering it with rugs or carpet.

cleaning.text: The technical sheet gives dry dusting for the first 7 days and discusses a separate 2-week window for liquid cleaners. Confirm the first damp or cleaner use.

cure.text: The technical sheet describes full cure at about 7 days.

products.name: DuraSeal Waterbased Polyurethane
products.scope: Manufacturer instructions for the waterbased product. Confirm the product name on the label.

walking.text: DuraSeal lists 24 hours before light foot traffic.

furniture.text: Ask for a separate furniture date. The published instructions give a one-week heavy traffic restriction.

rugs.text: The manufacturer says to wait one week before putting rugs on the finish.

cleaning.text: The manufacturer gives a one-week wait before using cleaners. Check the specified cleaner on the product instructions.

cure.text: The instructions give a one-week restriction for rugs, cleaners, spills and heavy traffic. Confirm full cure separately for your floor.
